Digniino weerar nukleer oo been abuur ah oo loo diray bulshooyinka Ruushka iyo Ukraine
Published
Waqtiga akhriska: 5 daqiiqo
Ukraine iyo Ruushka labaduba waxay sheegeen in barnaamijyada digniinta hawada la jabsaday habeenkii Axadda ka dib markii farriimo been abuur ah oo digniin ah oo ku saabsan weeraro, oo ay ku jiraan nukliyeerka, loo diray dadka isticmaala.
Barnaamijka si weyn loo isticmaalo ee Ukraine ayaa digniino cirka ah oo heer sare ah u diray dalka oo dhan, iyadoo digniino dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan shucaaca, weerarrada kiimikada, iyo dagaalka waddooyinka loo diray qaar ka mid ah dadka deggan meelaha ay ku jirto Kyiv.
Dhowr saacadood ka dib, mas'uuliyiinta Ruushka ayaa sheegay in barnaamij la mid ah kaas oo ay leeyihiin la jabsaday ka dib markii digniino been abuur ah, oo qaarkood ay ku jiraan luqad xun, la sii daayay.
Ma cadda cidda ka dambeysay weerarrada internetka ama in labada dhacdo ay isku xirnaayeen.
Muwaadiniin badan oo reer Ukraine ah ayaa la qabsaday inay helaan digniino ku dhawaad habeen kasta ah oo ku saabsan weerarrada gantaalada Ruushka iyo diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn - laakiin Axaddii, dadka isticmaala waxaa lagu boorriyay inay u jeestaan ilo kale oo macluumaad ay ka helaan.
Qoraal ay ku qoreen Telegram, ciidamada cirka ayaa yiri: "Codsiga Digniinta Hawada waxaa laga yaabaa in lagu sameeyay faragelin banaanka ah. Ma jirto khatar shucaac ah! Is deji oo la soco xogaha cusub ee kanaalkayaga."
Dowladdu waxay sheegtay inay si ku meel gaar ah u joojisay barnaamijka dayactirka app-ka, iyadoo sheegtay in "sida muuqata la jabsaday".
Farriimaha been abuurka ah waxaa lagu qoray afka Ruushka, taasoo u sheegi lahayd dad badan oo isticmaala xaqiiqda ah inaysan ahayn kuwo sharci ah.
Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp.
Halkaan kaga soo biir
Dhamaadka xayeysiinta
Laakiin Olena, oo deggan magaalada Kyiv, ayaa barnaamijka 'Today' ee BBC Radio 4 u sheegtay inay aad u argagaxday, iyadoo tiri: "Fikirka ugu horreeyay ee maskaxdayda ku soo dhacay wuxuu ahaa 'Ilaahayow, tan diyaar uma ihi'.
"Waxaan diyaar u ahay koronto la'aan, iyo in la joojiyo kululeeyaha guryaha iyo biyaha, laakiin diyaar uma ihi weerar nukliyeer ah."
Olena waxay sheegtay in ninkeeda ay soo gaareen farriimo digniin ah oo ku saabsan "dagaallo waddooyinka ka socda oo ka dhacaya Kyiv," iyo farriin kale oo ku qoran luuqadda Ruushka.
"Markaas ka dib ayaan fahmay in qof uu jabsaday ama weerar ku qaaday barnaamijka (app-ka), sababtoo ah dhammaan ogeysiisyada aan helno waxay ku qoran yihiin luuqadda Yukraynka."
Dalka Ruushka, dowladdu waxay sheegtay in barnaamijkeeda app-ka uu sidoo kale noqday bartilmaameedka "weerar dhanka internetka ah oo baaxad weyn", kaas oo dadweynaha u diray "macluumaad been abuur ah".
Sawir shaashadda laga qaaday oo la sheegay inuu yahay digniin been abuur ah ayaa waxaa barta Telegram-ka soo dhigay kooxda 'Atesh' — oo ah koox u dagaallanta dhinaca Ukraine, balse ka hawlgasha dhulalka uu Ruushku haysto.
Digniintaas ayaa isticmaalayaasha qaar uga digaysay in "madaxyada hubka nukliyeerka ah — oo lagu xiray diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ee Ukraine ee loo yaqaan P1-Suns — lagu weeraray dhammaan gobollada Ruushka".
Digniinta, oo ay ku jireen erayo cay ah, ayaa ku bilaabatay farriin dadka deegaanka u sheegaysa inay jirto "halis ah in xaaladdu ay noqoto mid kacsan," waxayna ku amartay inay "si degdeg ah u kaydsadaan cunto ku filan saddex toddobaad, ayna dhuuntaan."
Subaxnimadii Isniinta, ma jirin wax muujinaya in farriimahaasi ay sababeen cabsi baahsan oo ka dhex dhalata Ruushka, mana jirin in dhacdadan si weyn looga hadlay warbaahinta.
Markii wax laga weydiiyay jabsashadan, afhayeenka Kremlin-ka Dmitry Peskov si gaar ah ugama hadlin, balse wuxuu sheegay in dhammaan ilaha internetka ee dowladda Ruushku ay "si uun... ula kulmaan weerarro dhanka internetka ah oo joogto ah," oo ay ku jirto bogga internetka ee madaxtooyada, kaas oo la beegsado "habeen iyo maalinba."
Wuxuu sheegay in baahsanaanta tiknoolajiyadda garaadka macmalka ah (AI) ay gacan ka geysanayso kororka weerarrada dhanka internetka ah.
Wasaaradda Difaaca Ruushka ayaa Isniintii sheegtay in "shaqada buuxda" ee barnaamijkaas la soo celin doono "ka hor dhammaadka maalinta," ayna sheegtay in jabsashadu aysan saameyn ku yeelan nidaamka guud ee digniinta.
Inkastoo si weyn loo aaminsan yahay in Ruushka iyo Ukraine ay weerarro dhanka internetka ah isku qaadaan, haddana luuqadda aan rasmiga ahayn ee lagu isticmaalay digniinnada been abuurka ah ee Axaddii ayaa tilmaamaysa kooxo loo yaqaan "hacktivists" (dad u adeegsada jabsashada internetka ujeeddooyin siyaasadeed ama u doodid). Kooxahan ayaa laga yaabaa inay xiriir la leeyihiin Moscow ama Kyiv, balse si rasmi ah uma hoos tagaan midkoodna dowladahaas.
Khubarada dhanka internetka ayaa u sheegay BBC-da in haddii jabsashada nidaamka Ruushku ay ahayd tallaabo aargoosi ah, ay u badan tahay in dadka ka dambeeya ay horeyba u lahaayeen awoodda ay ku sameeyaan, maadaama helitaanka nidaamkaas ay u baahan tahay waqti iyo agab.
Oleksander Merezhko, oo ah guddoomiyaha guddiga arrimaha dibadda ee baarlamaanka Ukraine, ayaa u sheegay BBC-da in weerarku uusan sababin cabsi ama falcelin xad-dhaaf ah.
Merezhko wuxuu sheegay in dadka reer Ukraine, gaar ahaan kuwa ku nool Kyiv, ay la qabsadeen "digniino aan kala joogsi lahayn", isagoo raaciyay "fariintani waxay ku qorneed luqadda Ruushka taasoo isla markiiba abuurtay shaki".
Wuxuu sii raaciyay: "Waa xaqiiqo aad u xun laakiin waa qayb ka mid ah dagaalka internetka dadka reer Ukrainena way fahmeen taas. Waa suurtagal waanan u diyaarsanahay fursadaha noocaas ah."
Herbert Lin, oo ah cilmi-baare sare oo ka tirsan siyaasadda internetka iyo amniga Jaamacadda Stanford, ayaa u sheegay barnaamijka Newsday ee BBC World Service: "Waxaan u maleynayaa inay tahay markii ugu horreysay ee ay ku dhacdo barnaamij macluumaad oo rasmi ah oo Ukraine leedahay, laakiin waxaan u maleynayaa inaysan noqon doonin kii ugu dambeeyay."
Digniinaha Ukraine waxaa la diray daqiiqado ka hor dhammaadka xabbad-joojin maxalli ah oo ka dhacday gobolka Kherson ee safka hore ee Ukraine, kaas oo la hirgeliyay Talaadadii la soo dhaafay.
Dagaalku wuxuu ka sii socday meelo kale intii xabbad-joojintii Kherson ay socotay, taas oo qayb ahaan ay dhexdhexaadisay Marwada Koowaad ee Mareykanka Melania Trump si loogu oggolaado dadka rayidka ah inay ka baxaan magaalada Oleshky ee Ruushku haysto.

Weather tomorrow, November 3: Rainfall warning in Andhra Pradesh
Andhra Pradesh is likely to experience some of the worst weather conditions as Cyclone Murasu approaches the coast. Rayalaseema is also likely to receive heavy to very heavy rainfall at a few places, with extremely heavy rainfall at isolated locations.
The IMD has warned of strong winds along the Andhra Pradesh coast, covering Krishna, Bapatla, Prakasam, SPSR Nellore, Guntur, Eluru, NTR, Palnadu and West Godavari districts.
Wind speeds may reach 70-80 kmph, with gusts of up to 90 kmph, by Tuesday morning after landfall. They are expected to decrease further to 40-50 kmph, with gusts reaching 60 kmph, by Tuesday evening.
Telangana weather forecast: Heavy rain and strong winds on November 3
Telangana is also likely to see an increase in rainfall activity on Tuesday. The IMD has forecast light to moderate rainfall at most places, with heavy to very heavy rainfall at a few places and extremely heavy rainfall at isolated locations on November 3.The warning covers Khammam, Suryapet, Nalgonda, Nagarkurnool, Wanaparthy, Mahabubabad, Warangal, Jangaon, Karimnagar and Bhadradri Kothagudem districts.
Strong winds are also expected in these areas. Wind speeds may reach 70-80 kmph, with gusts of up to 90 kmph, from the early hours until the forenoon of November 3. Wind speeds are likely to decrease gradually afterwards.
Tamil Nadu weather tomorrow: Rain alert in Chennai and nearby districts
North Tamil Nadu may receive light to moderate rainfall at many places, with heavy rainfall at isolated locations on November 3.The IMD has issued a wind warning for Chennai, Thiruvallur, Ranipet, Kancheepuram and Chengalpattu districts, along with the Puducherry coast.
Wind speeds of 40-50 kmph, with gusts reaching 60 kmph, are expected until Tuesday evening. Sea conditions along the north Tamil Nadu and Puducherry coasts are likely to remain rough to very rough until the morning of November 4.
Odisha weather forecast: Rain and strong winds in southern districts
Southern Odisha may also experience rainfall and strong winds on November 3.The IMD has forecast light to moderate rainfall at many places, with heavy rainfall at isolated locations in the region. The warning covers Malkangiri, Koraput, Rayagada, Gajapati and Ganjam districts.
Wind speeds may reach 50-60 kmph, with gusts of up to 70 kmph, until Tuesday noon. They are expected to decrease gradually afterwards.
Chhattisgarh weather forecast: Rain likely in southern parts
South Chhattisgarh is likely to receive light to moderate rainfall at many places, with heavy rainfall at isolated locations on November 3.The IMD has issued a rainfall warning for the region for November 2-4, with isolated heavy rainfall likely during this period.
IMD warns of rough sea conditions along the coast
The IMD has warned that sea conditions will remain dangerous in several parts of the Bay of Bengal and along the east coast on November 3.Very high sea conditions are expected over the westcentral Bay of Bengal until Tuesday morning. Conditions are likely to improve gradually, becoming very rough to rough by Wednesday morning, November 4.
Along the Andhra Pradesh coast, high to very high sea conditions are expected until Tuesday morning. The sea is likely to remain rough to very rough along the north Tamil Nadu and Puducherry coasts until Wednesday morning.
Southern Odisha's coastal areas may also experience rough to very rough sea conditions until Tuesday morning.
Cyclone Murasu: IMD issues storm surge warning for Andhra Pradesh
The weather department has warned of a possible storm surge of 1.5-2 metres above the astronomical tide in low-lying areas of south coastal Andhra Pradesh during the cyclone's landfall.The highest surge is expected in Bapatla, Krishna and Prakasam districts. The IMD said the storm surge could exceed 0.5 metres from the evening of November 2 and continue until Tuesday morning, with a peak of 1-1.5 metres during the night and early hours of November 3.
People living in low-lying coastal areas should follow instructions issued by local authorities.
IMD issues fishermen warning: Avoid venturing into the sea
The IMD has advised fishermen not to venture into several parts of the Bay of Bengal and along the east coast due to rough weather and strong winds.Fishing activities have been restricted along the Andhra Pradesh coast until the afternoon of November 4. Fishermen have also been advised to stay away from the north Tamil Nadu-Puducherry coast until the morning of November 4.
Similar warnings are in place for the southwest and westcentral Bay of Bengal and the south Odisha coast.
People living in coastal areas are advised to follow weather updates and safety instructions issued by the IMD and local authorities.

Heavy rain is likely to lash parts of Kerala until Wednesday under the influence of a cyclone over the Bay of Bengal, with the India Meteorological Department (IMD) issuing yellow alerts for six districts on Monday.
Palakkad, Malappuram, Kozhikode, Wayanad, Kannur and Kasaragod have been placed on yellow alert, indicating the possibility of isolated heavy rainfall. Northern Kerala is expected to receive comparatively heavier showers during the spell.
The rain warning will cover Kozhikode, Kannur, Wayanad and Kasaragod on Tuesday. On Wednesday, Pathanamthitta, Idukki, Malappuram and Kozhikode will remain under a heavy rainfall warning, according to the forecast.
The IMD defines heavy rainfall as precipitation ranging from 64.5 mm to 115.5 mm within 24 hours. The forecast points to isolated spells of this intensity rather than uniformly heavy rain across all areas of the districts concerned.
The cyclone is expected to cross the southern Andhra Pradesh coast between Nellore and Narasapur during the period from midnight on Monday to 4 a.m. on Tuesday. According to the weather department, it is likely to make landfall as a severe cyclonic storm, with wind speeds reaching up to 120 kmph.
Although Kerala is not expected to face the cyclone’s direct impact, the associated weather conditions could bring heavy showers accompanied by thunderstorms and lightning to several parts of the State over the next two to three days.
The forecast indicates that the rainfall risk will remain concentrated in the northern districts initially, before extending to parts of central and southern Kerala by Wednesday.
The district-wise warnings reflect a shifting pattern of rainfall during the three-day period. Kozhikode features in the warnings for all three days, while Wayanad, Kannur and Kasaragod are covered on both Monday and Tuesday. Malappuram has been included in the alerts issued for Monday and again for Wednesday.

Cyclone ‘Murasu’ to bring rain to Jabalpur, Indore and Rewa:Storms and rain expected across MP until November 5; Shahdol and Narmadapuram to be affected too
Fog blanketed Vidisha and Tikamgarh on Sunday morning.
Daytime temperatures have fallen in Madhya Pradesh due to Cyclone 'Arnab'. The maximum temperature has dropped by 7 to 8 degrees in just four days. Night-time temperatures have also begun to fall.
According to the IMD (weather centre), thunderstorms and rain will continue across the state until 5 November due to the new storm 'Murasu'. A warning of strong winds and rain has been issued for Jabalpur, Narsinghpur, Chhindwara, Pandhurna, Seoni, Balaghat, Mandla, Dindori, Katni, Umaria, Anuppur, Shahdol, Maihar, Sidhi and Singrauli on Monday.
Earlier, on Sunday, thunderstorms and drizzle occurred in parts of Singrauli, Sidhi, Rewa, Mauganj, Satna, Anuppur, Shahdol, Umaria, Dindori, Chhindwara, Seoni, Mandla, Balaghat, Maihar and Pandhurna.
New storm to affect these districts According to the weather department, the new storm will affect districts in the Jabalpur, Rewa, Shahdol, Narmadapuram and Indore divisions of the state. Bhopal, Ujjain, Gwalior, Chambal and Sagar divisions will remain cloudy. There may also be drizzle in some places.
Daytime temperatures fall Over the past 48 hours, maximum temperatures fell by 5.3 degrees to 7.7 degrees in the Chambal, Rewa, Shahdol and Sagar divisions. The mercury fell by up to 4.9 degrees in the Bhopal, Indore, Narmadapuram, Ujjain, Gwalior and Jabalpur divisions.
Night-time temperatures, meanwhile, fell by 1 to 2 degrees. Last night, temperatures of 14.5 degrees were recorded in Damoh, 15.1 degrees in Amarkantak, 15.2 degrees in Bhopal, 15.4 degrees in Girwar in Shajapur and 15.8 degrees Celsius in Malajkhand in Balaghat.
Now, find out what the weather will be like in November According to the Meteorological Department, the cold will intensify from the second week of November. The mercury will fall particularly in the districts of the Gwalior-Chambal division, where northerly winds arrive directly. In Gwalior, the night-time temperature reached a record low of 3 degrees Celsius in November 57 years ago.
Ujjain's minimum temperature fell to a record 2.3°C 53 years ago. Bhopal, Indore and Jabalpur have a trend of rainfall this month. There is a rain alert at the very beginning of November this time. Rain may also occur if a weather system becomes active in the third and fourth weeks.
Know the weather in 5 major cities in November...
Bhopal: Rainfall recorded 3 times in 10 years In November, night temperatures in the state capital reach 9 to 12 degrees Celsius. This has been the trend for the past 10 years. This time too, temperatures will fall rapidly from the second week. According to the Meteorological Department, Bhopal's night temperature has fallen to as low as 6.1 degrees in November. This was recorded on 30 November 1941. November also has a trend of receiving rain. Rainfall has been recorded 3 times in 10 years. More than 5.5 inches of rain fell in the month in 1936.
Indore: Minimum temperature has fallen to 5.6°C The cold is felt in Indore. The temperature drops rapidly, especially from the second week onwards. As a result, the nights become cold and the temperature remains between 10°C and 12°C. However, the temperature fell to 5.6°C on 25 November 1938. It also rains occasionally. Daytime temperatures remain between 31°C and 33°C.
Gwalior: 3 inches of rain fell in 1927 Looking at the figures for the past 10 years, Gwalior's temperature has fallen to 8 degrees. Fifty-four years ago, in 1970, the temperature fell to 3 degrees. This is the overall record. On 2 November 2001, the daytime temperature reached 37.3 degrees, while it generally remains between 33 and 35 degrees. The city also receives rain this month. More than 3 inches of rain fell throughout the month in 1927. Similar weather has occurred three times in 10 years.
Jabalpur: More than 6 inches of rain in 1946 Over the past 10 years, the minimum temperature fell to 7.8 degrees in 2022. The overall record was recorded on 12 November 1989, when the temperature fell to 3.9 degrees. More than 6 inches of rain was recorded throughout the month in 1946. It has rained twice in 10 years. Daytime temperatures remain between 30 and 33 degrees.
Ujjain: Minimum temperature remains between 10°C and 11°C On 30 November 1974, the night-time temperature reached 2.8°C here. This remains the overall record. Meanwhile, the daytime temperature was 36.5°C on 6 November 2008. Over the past 10 years, the minimum temperature has remained between 10°C and 11°C, while the daytime temperature has reached between 33°C and 35°C.

The Ukrainian Hydrometeorological Center has issued a yellow alert for five regions
The Ukrainian Hydrometeorological Center has issued a Level I (yellow) hazard warning due to fog in five regions of Ukraine for Tuesday, November 3. Forecasters warn of significantly deteriorating weather conditions in the northeastern part of the country overnight and in the morning.
Thick fog with visibility limited to 200–500 meters is forecast in the Chernihiv, Sumy, Poltava, Kharkiv, and Luhansk regions. Overall, cloudy weather without significant precipitation will prevail across the country, with the exception of the Odesa region and Crimea, where light rain is expected, as well as the Carpathians, where wet snow is forecast. Temperatures will range from +2° to +8° at night and from +5° to +11° during the day, reaching up to +15° in the southeast.
Source: Ukrainian Hydrometeorological Center.
A gradual cooling is expected in Ukraine in November, though overall the month may be warmer than the climatological norm. Forecasters do not predict severe or prolonged frosts.
This winter in Ukraine, precipitation may exceed the climatological norm by 20–40%. However, this does not mean the season will be snowy: due to the prevalence of warm air from the Atlantic, precipitation will often fall as rain or wet snow.
